description: 2x2 prioritization matrix with drag-and-drop between quadrants (Quick Wins, Big Bets, Fill-Ins, Money Pit)

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL to a JSON array of items ({ id, quadrant, label }). Fetched once per value; a new value replaces the items and aborts an older in-flight request

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Reduces grid height, padding, and label sizes for denser layouts

childAttributes.name: data-quadrant
childAttributes.description: Target quadrant for this item (default quick-wins); kept up to date as the item is dragged

childAttributes.name: draggable
childAttributes.description: Required for drag capability (added if missing)

childAttributes.name: data-id
childAttributes.description: Stable identifier for the item, used as the .items key (generated if missing)

events.name: impact-effort:move
events.description: Fired when an item is dragged between quadrants; from and to are quadrant names

events.name: impact-effort:ready
events.description: Fired once after the first render, with the number of items per quadrant. With src, fired once the loaded cards are in the DOM (after the View Transition's update), and again after each later src change. Not re-fired when the matrix is moved in the DOM

events.name: impact-effort:upgraded
events.description: Fired (in a microtask) each time the matrix connects and upgrades
